rules: Mic check before every take: record 5 seconds, listen back with headphones. If you can't hear it clearly, don't roll.
Two phones? Clap once in shot at the start so the clips line up in CapCut.
3 takes minimum of each ad. Keep the ad-libs.
Keep foam and water away from the phones and the mic.
Only water and car shampoo on people. Never real chemicals. Degreaser on the chain only.
Blur number plates in the edit.
On-screen text stays out of the top 14% and bottom 35% of the screen.
Every ad says 'we come to you' out loud.
A price on screen = the price said in that video. No made-up claims.
kit: Old hoodie, old shoes, sunglasses for Ananth
Towels + full change of clothes for Ananth and Angus
A bike + a rider in full gear
Chain degreaser + chain lube, soft bike brushes
Headlight kit (sandpaper, polisher, sealant), masking tape, phone torch
